title: Specification of emitted minterms
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be any Boolean function on assignments to $n$ variables. Run the input-negation gates first, then emit one AND tree for each assignment on which $f$ is true, using as that tree's leaves the literals selected by the assignment. The resulting gates extend the input-negation gates and are acyclic; the output list has one vertex per satisfying assignment, each output vertex is less than $n$ plus the total number of resulting gates, and the value at each output equals the corresponding AND of minterm leaves evaluated after the input-negation gates. The total number of gates is at most $n$ plus the sum, over the satisfying assignments, of the tree cost of a list of $n$ leaves; every newly emitted gate is an AND gate with distinct inputs and at most two inputs.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on assignments to $n$ variables
